purpose: Place art outside the kit meshes (#10044): the painted moss PlaceMossCards grows where the surface moss field is strong: ivy curtains on lips, ivy on side faces, cushions at wall feet, and flat mats on tops. The surface shader under them is only a soft damp stain.

moss-cards.generator: local Qwen-Image-2.1 text-to-image on the owner's RTX 5090 (asset-pipeline tools/texture-edit/qwen_edit.py --size 1024x1024)
moss-cards.assembly: python3 scripts/make-grass-atlas.py content/game/textures/places/moss-cards.png <ivy-s81 flipped> <ivy-s81 flipped and mirrored> <foot-s71> <foot-s72> --cell 128 --key magenta --ramps foliage,sage,meadow (the curtain flipped so its attached edge is the cell's base; ivy-s82 and -s83 were dropped for a painted rod along their tops; the first stringy hanging-moss curtain hang-s71 was replaced at the owner's request for a denser leafier ivy mat)

cells.prompt: a dense mat of ivy hanging down from a straight horizontal line along the top edge of the image, overlapping chunky ivy leaves packed close together in clusters, a full leafy mass at the top thinning into a few leafy trailing tendrils of different lengths below, dark green, olive and a few bright yellow-green leaves catching the light, flat side view, hand-painted game texture sprite in the style of Valheim and 2000s games, broad painterly brush strokes, readable leaf shapes, soft shading, isolated on a pure flat magenta background, no wall, no stone, no rod, no branch, no shadow, no text, fills the frame width
